d: US President Donald Trump and California Governor Gavin Newsom are locked in a fiery political showdown over the death penalty, presidential pardons and criminal justice. Trump attacks Newsom's plan to commute all 548 California death sentences to life without parole, calling it a shocking injustice to victims' families. At a Justice Department appearance alongside Attorney General Todd Blanche and FBI Director Kash Patel, Trump vows to accelerate federal executions and expand the use of capital punishment for certain child murders, rapes and human-trafficking killings. Newsom fires back,…
